47604-the-belle-s-stratagem.title: The Belle S Stratagem
47604-the-belle-s-stratagem.creator: Mrs. Cowley.
47604-the-belle-s-stratagem.description: A book by Mrs. Cowley.. _Court._ I was informed a few days since, that my cousins Fallow were come to town, and desired earnestly to see me at their lodgings in Warwick-Court, Holborn. Away drove I, painting them all the way as so many Hebes. They came from the farthest part of Northumberland, had never been in town, and in course were made up of rusticity, innocence, and beauty.

arxiv-2107-12224.title: Local2Global: Scaling global representation learning on graphs via local training Conference: ; ;
arxiv-2107-12224.creator: Lucas G. S. Jeub, Giovanni Colavizza, Xiaowen Dong, Marya Bazzi, Mihai Cucuringu
arxiv-2107-12224.description: Abstract . We propose a decentralised “ local2global ” approach to graph representation learning, that one can a-priori use to scale any embedding technique. Our local2global approach proceeds by first dividing the input graph into overlapping subgraphs (or “ patches ”) and training local representations for each patch independently.

arxiv-2201-00114.title: Machine learning analysis of cocaine addiction informed by DAT, SERT, and NET-based interactome networks
arxiv-2201-00114.creator: Hongsong Feng, Kaifu Gao, Dong Chen, Alfred J Robison, Edmund Ellsworth, Guo-Wei Wei
arxiv-2201-00114.description: Abstract Cocaine addiction is a psychosocial disorder induced by the chronic use of cocaine and causes a large of number deaths around the world. Despite many decades’ effort, no drugs have been approved by the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) for the treatment of cocaine dependence. Cocaine dependence is neuro- logical and involves many interacting proteins in the interactome.

arxiv-2302-13677.title: A study of carbon-rich post-AGB stars in the Milky Way to understand the production of carbonaceous dust from evolved stars
arxiv-2302-13677.creator: S. Tosi, D. Kamath, F. Dell’Agli, H. Van Winckel, P. Ventura, T. Marchetti, E. Marini, M. Tailo
arxiv-2302-13677.description: Abstract Context. Knowledge of the 𝐺𝐴𝐼𝐴 \it{GAIA} DR3 parallaxes of Galactic post-asymptotic giant branch (AGB) stars makes it possible to exploit these objects as tracers of AGB evolution, nucleosynthesis, and dust production as well as to use them to shed new light on still poorly known physical processes experienced by AGB stars. Aims.

arxiv-2303-14321.title: Exact Short Products From Truncated Multipliers
arxiv-2303-14321.creator: Daniel Lemire
arxiv-2303-14321.description: Abstract We sometimes need to compute the most significant digits of the product of small integers with a multiplier requiring much storage: e.g., a large integer (e.g., 5 100 5^{100} ) or an irrational number ( π \pi ). We only need to access the most significant digits of the multiplier—as long as the integers are sufficiently small.

arxiv-2307-00584.title: Cops and robber on variants of retracts and subdivisions of oriented graphs
arxiv-2307-00584.creator: Harmender Gahlawat, Zin Mar Myint, Sagnik Sen ( a ) (a) Ben-Gurion University of the Negev, Beersheba, Israel ( b ) (b) Indian Institute of Technology Dharwad, India.
arxiv-2307-00584.description: Abstract Cops and Robber is one of the most studied two-player pursuit-evasion games played on graphs, where multiple cops , controlled by one player, pursue a single robber . The main parameter of interest is the cop number of a graph, which is the minimum number of cops that can ensure the capture of the robber.

arxiv-2403-01184.title: Controllable Subspaces in Structured Networks of Hierarchical Directed Acyclic Graphs: Controllability of Individual Nodes
arxiv-2403-01184.creator: Nam-Jin Park, Yeong-Ung Kim, Koog-Hwan Oh, Hyo-Sung Ahn
arxiv-2403-01184.description: Abstract This paper introduces the concept of the Fixed Strongly Structurally Controllable Subspace (FSSCS) within the context of structured networks, enabling a comprehensive characterization of controllable subspaces. From a graph-theoretical perspective, we define Fixed Strongly Structurally Controllable (FSSC) nodes, which are nodes (or states) that remain controllable for all network parameters within a structured network.

arxiv-2409-08567.title: Study of entanglement and phase transitions in the coupled top systems with standard and nonstandard symmetries
arxiv-2409-08567.creator: Rashmi Jangid Sharma, Jayendra N. Bandyopadhyay
arxiv-2409-08567.description: Abstract We study classical and quantum versions of a coupled top system in the absence and the presence of nonlinear torsion in the individual top. The model without the torsion and couples two identical tops is well-known in the literature as the Feingold-Peres (FP) model. The permutation and chiral symmetries are preserved in the FP model.

pmc-10536524.title: Early Detection of Phenotypic Diversity of Alfalfa (Medicago sativa L.) in Response to Temperature
pmc-10536524.creator: Abraham J. Escobar-Gutiérrez, Lina Q. Ahmed
pmc-10536524.description: Climate change may have important consequences on plant distribution because local environments could change faster than the pace of natural selection and adaptation of wild populations and cultivars of perennial forages. Temperature is a primary factor affecting seed germination and primary heterotrophic growth processes. Medicago sativa (L.) is the most important forage legumes globally.

pmc-11342964.title: Implementation of the kissing balloon technique using a perfusion balloon in acute myocardial infarction: a case report
pmc-11342964.creator: Marohito Nakata, Tatsuya Tabata, Chikashi Nago, Masami Abe, Hiroki Uehara
pmc-11342964.description: BackgroundProlonged antiplatelet-agent administration associated with stenting for acute myocardial infarction is not ideal in young patients. We successfully performed a perfusion balloon-based kissing balloon technique in the left anterior descending artery ostium in a young patient with acute myocardial infarction.Case summaryA 34-year-old female presenting with recurrent chest pain was diagnosed with ST-segment elevation acute myocardial infarction.

pmc-11435981.title: Diffusion Wave Spectroscopy Microrheological Characterization of Gelling Agarose Solutions
pmc-11435981.creator: Nuria Mancebo, Ramon G Rubio, Francisco Ortega, Carlo Carbone, Eduardo Guzmán, Fernando Martínez-Pedrero, Miguel A Rubio, Xufeng Dong
pmc-11435981.description: This work investigated the gelation kinetics and mechanical properties of agarose hydrogels studied at different concentrations (in the range 1–5 g/L) and temperatures. Rheological measurements were performed by diffusing wave spectroscopy (DWS) using polystyrene and titanium dioxide particles as probes. The study emphasized the influence of gelation kinetics on the mechanical behavior of the hydrogels.

pmc-11453440.creator: B deSouza, F Huynh, K Anderson, I Batchvarov, B Capel, M Hirschey
pmc-11453440.description: Disclosure: B. deSouza: None. F. Huynh: None. K. Anderson: None. I. Batchvarov: None. B. Capel: None. M. Hirschey: None.Breastfeeding confers a wealth of benefits to both children and mothers. Breastfeeding can be impaired by metabolic diseases such as diabetes and obesity, which are known to interfere with both normal mammary gland development and lactogenesis, although mechanisms remain unclear.

pmc-11538754.title: 75 years of forensic profiling: A critical review
pmc-11538754.creator: Roberta Tittarelli, Sara Dagoli, Rossana Cecchi, Luigi Tonino Marsella, Francesco Saverio Romolo
pmc-11538754.description: The interest in characterization of drugs abused started in 1948 with the aim of determining the origin of opium. After 75 years there is still a great interest in this approach, called geo-profiling, chemical or forensic profiling in the following decades.

pmc-11593946.title: Optical Genome Mapping for Detection of BCR::ABL1—Another Tool in Our Toolbox
pmc-11593946.creator: Zhenya Tang, Wei Wang, Gokce A Toruner, Shimin Hu, Hong Fang, Jie Xu, M James You, L Jeffrey Medeiros, Joseph D Khoury, Guilin Tang, Roland P Kuiper
pmc-11593946.description: Background: BCR::ABL1 fusion is mostly derived from a reciprocal translocation t(9;22)(q34.1;q11.2) and is rarely caused by insertion. Various methods have been used for the detection of t(9;22)/BCR::ABL1, such as G-banded chromosomal analysis, fluorescence in situ hybridization (FISH), quantitative real-time reverse transcription-polymerase chain reaction (RT-PCR) and optical genome mapping (OGM).

pmc-12554041.title: Isolated subcoronal epispadias managed with dorsal Thiersch-Duplay urethroplasty: A case-based insight into technique selection and outcomes
pmc-12554041.creator: Fiona Yosephine, Jupiter Sibarani
pmc-12554041.description: Epispadias is a rare congenital anomaly with an abnormal dorsal urethral opening. Isolated subcoronal cases are uncommon and present specific surgical challenges. We report a 15-year-old male with isolated subcoronal epispadias presenting with an upward urinary stream since birth. He underwent dorsal Thiersch-Duplay urethroplasty without intraoperative complications. Postoperatively, vital signs remained stable, wound healing was satisfactory, and urinary stream improved.

pmc-12745603.title: Public Perceptions of Vasectomy in China: A Social Media Content Analysis of User-Generated Narratives on Rednote
pmc-12745603.creator: Hui-Quan Shu, Zheng-Mu Wu, Chao Feng
pmc-12745603.description: This study examines public perceptions of vasectomy in China through a content analysis of user-generated posts on Rednote, one of the country’s most influential social media platforms. A total of 106 posts published up to August 2025 were analyzed, focusing on individual experiences, decision-making processes, postoperative outcomes, and emotional tone.

pmc-13367978.description: The inflammatory response resulting from the abnormal accumulation of metabolites has been implicated in the pathogenesis of organ fibrosis; however, its role and underlying mechanisms in renal fibrosis remain unclear.
